issues.description: The candidate's exposed chest and shorts appear brighter and more orange than the original's muted warm peach and earthy brown.
issues.repair: Match the original skin and hide colors, retaining its subdued brown shading and irregular painterly tonal variation.

issues.description: A narrow pale-edged strip appears along the candidate's exposed shoulder beneath the beard, creating an extra boundary absent from the original's continuous chest contour.
issues.repair: Remove the shoulder-edge seam and reconnect the exposed chest directly beneath the beard, preserving the original asymmetric hide neckline.

issues.description: The candidate's shorts are narrower and their central crotch opening rises higher; the ragged leg hems also end higher than in the original.
issues.repair: Restore the original shorts width, lower crotch split, and individual torn hem points while keeping two distinct leg openings.

issues.description: The candidate's image-right arm bows outward around the elbow and then descends almost vertically to the hand. The original follows a more direct sloping contour from shoulder to wrist.
issues.repair: Trace the original image-right arm curve and shoulder attachment, matching its outward slope and hand position.

issues.description: The candidate's feet are flatter and more horizontal, particularly the image-left foot; the image-right foot is also shorter and loses the original's broad outward projection.
issues.repair: Restore the original ankle-to-foot transitions, tilted image-left foot, and broad image-right toe silhouette without flattening the stance.

warnings: Assessment is limited to the supplied static comparison image.
